desc:
🍔 Welcome to Burger Planet!

Released 8th October 2026.

Run your own fast food restaurant and turn a small burger joint into a thriving business. From the first order to the last clean table, every shift is in your hands!

🔥 Grill burgers, fry crispy fries, and pour drinks
🛎️ Take orders and keep your customers happy
📦 Order supplies, unpack deliveries, and restock your stations
🧽 Keep your restaurant clean and ready for the next rush
⭐ Earn money, build your reputation, and grow your business

Put on your apron, flip the OPEN sign, and get cooking!

👍 Enjoying the game? Leave a like and favourite Burger Planet!
